messages:
ravi: Quick heads-up — multiple users reported copy/paste failures from the README curl example. Backslash line-continuations are getting soft-wrapped on GitHub and people paste broken commands (lots of 401s or \u201ccommand not found\u201d).
ravi: Current README snippet in question:

```
curl https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \\
  -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

ravi: When the `\\` gets a trailing space or a soft-wrap, terminals treat the next line as a new command. Support tickets: #5752, #5759.

zoe: Ugh. We should add a one-line example and a PowerShell example. Also include a short note about fish shell needing $REDWOOD_API_KEY to be wrapped like $REDWOOD_API_KEY or using $REDWOOD_API_KEY in braces? (I'll confirm exact fish syntax).

zoe: One-liner proposal:

```
curl -sS --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat --data-raw '{"input":"hello"}'
```

sophie: While we're here, the JS quickstart still uses the old SDK call `client.generate(prompt)` which breaks with the new responses API. New canonical snippet needs to use `await client.responses.create({ input: "..." })` and show the import/await pattern. That mismatch is causing onboarding confusion.

sophie: Example JS update I can paste in the PR:

```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const response = await client.responses.create({ input: 'hello' });
console.log(response.output);
```

ravi: Perfect. Also let's add a tiny Troubleshooting section: "If a curl command fails after paste, try removing any trailing backslashes and run as a one-liner; on PowerShell use Invoke-RestMethod (example below)."

zoe: PowerShell snippet to include:

```powershell
$body = '{"input":"hello"}'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat' -Method Post -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' } -Body $body
```

docs-bot: Created issue #4410: "docs: update quickstart examples for SDK parity and fix curl copy/paste gotchas" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4410

zoe: I'll open a small PR against the docs repo with the one-liner, PS snippet, updated JS sample, and a Troubleshooting note. Tagging @sophie for review.

sophie: Happy to review; will check for any remaining old API references and run the sample code locally. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Linked PR #4421 to issue #4410 and scheduled a docs staging deploy for tomorrow.
